C0815.title: Probationary Developer Sentenced to 10 Months for Deleting Code After Termination
C0815.summary: In March 2021, Wang joined a Shanghai internet company as a system developer. After failing probation and being dismissed, he deleted all system code for an upcoming release on his last day, causing project delays and costing the company tens of thousands of yuan in data recovery. The court sentenced Wang to 10 months in prison.

references.title: Programmer Gets Ten Months for Deleting Database After Being Fired During Probation; Netizens: Company's Access Management Is Also to Blame
